children.text: Keep model versions and their evaluation evidence together.
Registered models, checkpoints, and their intended tasks.
Registry state is a recorded label. Metadata registration and fixture results do not establish production model qualification.
Explore one recorded run at a time. Different suites are not treated as comparable.
Values, sample counts, and uncertainty as recorded.
